title: Hear God’s Voice Clearly: The 5 Filters
hook: Think it’s God? Run it through these five filters.
script: Think it’s God? Run it through these five filters. First, Scripture: does it agree with God’s Word? (2 Timothy 3:16). Second, Christlikeness: does it look like Jesus and lead you nearer to His voice? (John 10:27). Third, peace and fruit: does Christ’s peace rule and will it grow love, joy, and self-control? (Colossians 3:15; Galatians 5:22–23). Fourth, wise counsel: do mature believers confirm it? (Proverbs 11:14). Fifth, providence: are doors opening without striving? (Revelation 3:8). God leads; we test (1 Thessalonians 5:21). He isn’t offended by carefulness. Screenshot this, pray “Lord, align me,” and notice how clarity returns.

title: Case Study: Was That God or Just Me?
hook: You think God said, Quit now—here’s how to know if it’s Him or hurry.
script: You think God said, Quit now—here’s how to know if it’s Him or hurry. First, Scripture: God values faithfulness and wise planning, not panic (Proverbs 16:3; Luke 14:28). Second, Christlikeness: is the motive love, humility, and service, not ego or escape? Third, peace and fruit: is there steady peace and growing patience, or chaos and dread? Fourth, counsel: do trusted believers confirm timing? (Proverbs 11:14). Fifth, providence: are doors opening without forcing? (Revelation 3:8). If red flags stack up, pause. Serve well, prepare, and keep listening. My sheep hear My voice (John 10:27). Save this so you can test the next nudge.

title: 30-Second Discernment Practice
hook: If you have thirty seconds, you can test a thought from God.
script: If you have thirty seconds, you can test a thought from God. Breathe and pray, Speak, Lord, your servant is listening (1 Samuel 3:9). Write the impression. Open Scripture and find one verse that supports or corrects it. Ask, Does this look like Jesus? Check for Christ’s peace ruling in your heart (Colossians 3:15). Name the fruit it will grow. Text one wise friend for counsel (Proverbs 11:14). Pray, Jesus, open the right door and close the wrong one (Revelation 3:8). Release the outcome. God wants to guide you. Screenshot to save this daily filter.
